title: Desktop JS path: saving the last question never advances to the review screen (no-JS POST and mobile JS both do)
detail: On desktop shouldStep(isMobile) is false, so the review-assign branch never runs. The no-JS POST 303s to the bare URL and the mobile JS assigns it; desktop JS users only see a "Saved" marker, with no in-page path to the review (a reload of the ?q= URL re-renders the form page, not the review).
recommended_fix: When the final-question PUT succeeds and shouldStep is false, navigate to the bare URL (same location.assign as the mobile branch) so desktop JS users reach the review screen.

title: Mobile stepper focus() targets the hidden _question input, so the intended focus move never lands on a visible control
detail: querySelector("input, textarea, button") returns the form's first input, the type=hidden _question field, so focus() is a no-op on every mobile step; keyboard and screen-reader focus never moves to the newly shown question's real control.
recommended_fix: Exclude hidden inputs before focusing, e.g. querySelector("input:not([type=hidden]), textarea, button"), so focus lands on the first visible control of the stepped-to question.

title: fetch/FormData unguarded after preventDefault: in a fetch-less JS environment the submit is swallowed with no native-POST fallback
detail: preventDefault() runs before the unguarded fetch call; a missing fetch throws a ReferenceError out of the handler, so neither the PUT nor the native POST fallback (which only handles promise rejection) fires. Every other capability in the file is typeof-guarded; fetch is not.
recommended_fix: Guard before preventDefault: if (typeof root.fetch !== "function") return; so the unenhanced native POST path submits untouched.
